message: Hey John, just wanted to let you know that the garage sale was a huge success! We raised more than expected for the community fund!
Reminder: The project report is due at 1 PM. Don't forget to submit it on time!
Hi John, did you hear about the break-in on 5th street?
John, I heard about Dave's situation. He met some problem with his sexual relationship with Emily, but I hope he gets the help he needs. Maybe we can do something to help him as neighbors.
Looking for a good lawn care service, any recommendations?
Don't forget about the Lincoln Park Community Chat meeting next Thursday at 7 PM!
If anyone has photos from the last Lincoln Park Community Chat event, please share them in the chat or send them my way!

The Lincoln Park Community Chat is such a great way to stay connected with everyone, especially during these times. I encourage everyone to share some latest local happening. John, maybe we can start with you?
